Priya R: quick flag — candidate Maya (L5 SW Eng) accepted verbal. Hiring mgr wants an expedited onboard (start 2/1) and a one-time retention fee of $10k split across 6 months. comp band fits but retention is an exception. Need routing — can we get approvals this week? :pray:
Diego M: thanks. we should confirm manager budget ok. @Samir can you confirm headcount / team budget?
Samir P: headcount is fine, team has wiggle for one-time retention but needs finance & comp signoff. also note new hire is relocating so relocation reimbursement TBD.
Priya R: adding details: base $180k, standard eq, retention $10k (payable monthly x6), proposed start 2026-02-01. Candidate needs offer signed by Fri to make travel plans.
Kelsey F: from finance side — retention fee needs C-level or comp committee approval if >$8k. We can route to comp-committee but will need a short justification + impact statement.
Priya R: ok I'll draft justification. What wording do you want?
Kelsey F: include: business-critical role, time-to-fill risk, relocation timeline, and retention as split-pay makes it lower risk. attach manager note and org chart.
Priya R: @Diego can you paste one-sentence manager rationale and org chart link?
Diego M: manager rationale: "Candidate has unique infra experience and would unblock major rollout — replacing would take 4+ months and risk schedule slippage." org chart: https://drive.redwood/orgcharts/infra-team-v2 (view-only)
Priya R: routing plan: 1) people-ops initial review 2) comp-committee approval 3) CFO sign-off for $10k+ 4) finance to confirm payroll setup for split payments. Sound right?
Samir P: yea, add legal for employment paperwork and relocation policy check — cc: legal@redwood.com when ready.
Priya R: ok drafting request now. approvals-bot: Approval request created — ID AR-2026-478. Routing: comp-committee -> CFO. Expected SLA: 72h.
approvals-bot: @Kelsey F @Diego M please review and add comments in AR-2026-478.
Kelsey F: I'll review this afternoon. if comp-committee signs off we can loop CFO for final sign-off same day.
Priya R: one more ask — can we make start date flexible +2 weeks if approvals slip? manager says prefers 2/1 but can do 2/15 latest. putting that in offer language.
Diego M: flexible start OK. please include 2/15 fallback.
Priya R: great — I'll attach manager note + org chart + proposed offer language in the approval request. pinging here when submitted. :v:
